description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 Rate. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Reasoning Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 5 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Pass@1 Rate (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. A single blue line with circular markers represents GPT-4o; it begins at the point (5, 19.4), increases to (10, 32.3), continues to (20, 77.4), reaches a peak at (25, 87.1), and then declines to (40, 83.9).
